function resolvedBoxValuesCase(variant) {
  const checks={}, root=16+variant%8, own=root+4;
  document.documentElement.style.fontSize=`${root}px`;
  document.body.style.cssText='margin:0;width:800px';
  function make(css,parentCSS='') {
    const parent=document.createElement('main');parent.style.cssText=`position:relative;width:500px;font-size:${own}px;${parentCSS}`;
    const box=document.createElement('div');box.style.cssText='width:100px;height:50px;'+css;
    parent.append(box);document.body.append(parent);return {parent,box};
  }
  function check(name,css,property,expected,parentCSS='') {
    const {parent,box}=make(css,parentCSS);const value=getComputedStyle(box).getPropertyValue(property);
    checks[name]=value===expected;parent.remove();
  }
  check('width','width:96px','width','96px');
  check('height','height:1in','height','96px');
  check('ownEm',`font-size:${own}px;width:2em`,'width',`${2*own}px`);
  check('rootRem','width:2rem','width',`${2*root}px`);
  check('calcLength','width:calc(2rem + 5px)','width',`${2*root+5}px`);
  check('contentBox','padding:10px;border:2px solid red','width','100px');
  check('borderBox','box-sizing:border-box;padding:10px;border:2px solid red','width','100px');
  check('borderBoxMinimum','box-sizing:border-box;width:1px;padding:10px;border:2px solid red','width','24px');
  check('maxWidth','max-width:20px','width','20px');
  check('minWidth','min-width:120px','width','120px');
  check('maxHeight','max-height:20px','height','20px');
  check('minHeight','min-height:120px','height','120px');
  check('percentageWidth','width:20%','width','100px');
  check('percentagePadding','padding-top:10%','padding-top','50px');
  check('percentagePaddingHeight','padding-top:10%','height','50px');
  check('percentageMargin','margin-top:10%','margin-top','50px');
  check('percentagePaddingBorderBox','box-sizing:border-box;padding-top:10%','padding-top','50px');
  check('negativeMargin','margin-left:-2em','margin-left',`${-2*own}px`);
  check('autoMargin','margin-inline:auto','margin-left','200px');
  check('logicalWidth','inline-size:2rem','inline-size',`${2*root}px`);
  check('logicalHeight','block-size:2rem','block-size',`${2*root}px`);
  check('logicalPadding','padding-inline-start:2em','padding-left',`${2*own}px`);
  check('physicalPadding','padding-left:2rem','padding-inline-start',`${2*root}px`);
  check('logicalMargin','margin-block-end:2rem','margin-bottom',`${2*root}px`);
  check('cascade','padding-left:3px;padding-inline-start:5px','padding-left','5px');
  check('importantCascade','padding-left:3px!important;padding-inline-start:5px','padding-left','3px');
  check('variable','--size:2rem;width:var(--size)','width',`${2*root}px`);
  check('clampedPadding','padding-top:calc(1rem - 2rem)','padding-top','0px');
  check('nestedPercentagePadding','padding-top:10%','padding-top','34px','padding:10%;box-sizing:border-box');
  const geometry=make('padding-top:10%');
  checks.percentagePaddingGeometry=geometry.box.getBoundingClientRect().height===100;
  checks.percentagePaddingClient=geometry.box.clientHeight===100;
  geometry.parent.remove();
  const live=make('width:2em'), style=getComputedStyle(live.box);
  checks.liveInitial=style.width===`${2*own}px`;
  live.parent.style.fontSize='30px';checks.liveInheritedFont=style.width==='60px';
  live.box.style.width='2rem';document.documentElement.style.fontSize='30px';checks.liveRootFont=style.width==='60px';
  live.box.style.paddingLeft='10%';checks.livePadding=style.paddingLeft==='50px';
  live.parent.remove();checks.detached=style.width==='';
  const bodyStyle=getComputedStyle(document.body);checks.bodyMargin=bodyStyle.marginLeft==='0px';
  return checks;
}
